description: Patch an existing Novence form (name, slug, fields, notify_email, honeypot, active|disabled). Partial update: omitted fields stay unchanged. Use create_form for a new form; use list_forms to get form_id. Does not delete submissions.

fields.description: Replacement field list when provided. Omit to leave the current schema unchanged.

label.description: Visible label. Defaults to name if omitted.

name.description: HTML field name submitted with the form.

required.description: Whether the visitor must fill this field.

type.description: Input type rendered in the hosted form.

form_id.description: Form UUID from create_form or list_forms.

honeypot_field.description: Spam honeypot field name. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.description: New display name. Omit to leave unchanged.

notify_email.description: Notification inbox. Pass null to clear. Omit to leave unchanged.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

slug.description: New URL slug. Omit to leave unchanged.

status.description: active accepts submissions; disabled rejects them. Omit to leave unchanged.

name: update_form
title: Update form
